A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study and contain readable text, equations, figures, tables, and complete Appendices A–F. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that v3 retains the existing research content, with a small abstract edit and an inserted NeurIPS checklist.

before.justification: v2 reports original RFC-based hallucination analyses, controlled CoT editing experiments, and detection benchmarks in Section 3, with further empirical results in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and results, including the main detection benchmark and appendix analyses of other models, prompt alignment, and claim-level uncertainty.

M1.justification: The hallucination taxonomy, reasoning-chain model, reflection formulation, and auditing and intervention procedures remain unchanged in Section 2 and Appendices B–E.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same RFC documents, four hallucination/control subsets, and evaluation scenarios. The checklist adds no dataset, domain, or task coverage.

E2.justification: Table 3 retains Logit Entropy, Attention Strength, Spectral Entropy, HDM2, CCP, SelfCheckGPT, and Semantic Entropy. Comparator membership in Appendix B.2 and the claim-level analyses also remains unchanged.

E3.justification: Dataset sample counts, annotation and intervention protocols, evaluated models, metrics, and detection settings are identical. Checklist references to experimental details introduce no revised settings or new evaluation design.

E4.justification: The CoT-length analysis, neutral-prompt factuality test, intervention case studies, and segment-wise and claim-level detector analyses are retained unchanged in Appendices B–E.

E5.justification: Table 3 already reports uncertainty values in v2, and those entries and existing repeated-sampling information are unchanged. Checklist item 7 asserts variance reporting but adds no estimates, run counts, or statistical procedures.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings match throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 3 reports Semantic Entropy accuracy of 78.95% ± 0.67% in both versions. The checklist contains no additional results.

T1.justification: Assumptions A and B, Equations (1)–(4), controlled-domain constraints, and appendix computational-cost derivations are unchanged. The checklist's theory response does not alter this mathematical content.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about erroneous reflection, prompt-aligned bias, intervention failures, and black-box auditing. Removing 'Anthropic’s' before 'circuit tracing' does not substantively change these contributions.

C2.justification: Mechanistic interpretations and Appendix A's limitations remain unchanged, including reliance on qualitative audits rather than quantitative confidence estimation. The checklist adds general declarations without substantive new limitations or explanations.

D1.justification: Checklist items 4–5 and 13 newly state that both code and data are openly accessible and assets have accompanying documentation; v2 explicitly advertised code access. The repository link and technical appendices are unchanged, so this is an added disclosure, not evidence of a new release.

R1.justification: Section 4 and all 79 research references are unchanged. The abstract omits the organizational attribution to circuit tracing but retains the same comparison; added checklist policy links do not revise research positioning.

P1.justification: v3 inserts a 16-item NeurIPS checklist between the references and appendices, removes 'Anthropic’s' from the abstract, and updates the version/date stamp. The research narrative and appendix organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The abstract's line wrapping changes and seven checklist pages are inserted. Existing figures, tables, captions, and appendix page layouts remain visually identical apart from page numbers; no scientific display is redesigned.

improvement.justification: The checklist adds general assurances and more explicit asset-availability statements, but no actionable replication details or scientific evidence. The existing analyses, visual evidence, and substantive limitations remain unchanged. Together with the small abstract edit, these additions establish no meaningful net difference in overall quality.
